help_center_subtitle: Select a task-based walkthrough or launch the full interactive onboarding tour.
help_center_general_tour_desc: Step-by-step walkthrough covering role switching, tactical map, fire spread simulation, and risk analysis.
tutorial_click_target_hint: Click the highlighted element on your screen to advance to the next step.
tutorial_wrong_target_prompt: Please click inside the highlighted element to proceed.
tut_map_title: How to read the Tactical Map
tut_map_desc: Learn how to navigate GIS layers, inspect satellite fire hotspots, and monitor forest massifs.
tut_map_s1_desc: The live map integrates satellite thermal observations, terrain topography, and forest vegetation boundaries. Zoom in to explore local massif sectors.
tut_map_s1_hint: Click on the map area to interact with the surveillance grid.
tut_map_s2_desc: The tactical status ribbon continuously monitors NASA FIRMS VIIRS/MODIS hotspots, Open-Meteo weather sync, and active ML model accuracy.
tut_map_s2_hint: Click the status ribbon to inspect live telemetry.
tut_map_s3_desc: Quickly target high-risk forest massifs using the massif cards, labeled with official Wilaya administrative codes [W. N°].
tut_map_s3_hint: Click any forest massif card to center the viewport.
tut_map_s4_desc: Analyze real-time ignition and spread probabilities calculated by the XGBoost v2.1 model and the Canadian Forest Fire Weather Index (FWI).
tut_map_s4_hint: Click the AI risk panel to inspect risk factors.
tut_settings_desc: Configure trilingual display (EN, FR, AR), update your personnel avatar, and manage notification feeds.
tut_settings_s1_desc: Switch between English, French, and Arabic at any moment. Text direction, typography, and numbers adapt automatically.
tut_settings_s1_hint: Click the language selector to view supported languages.
tut_settings_s2_desc: Upload your official personnel photo (JPG/PNG max 2MB), update your contact telephone, or change your secure login password.
tut_settings_s2_hint: Click your profile dropdown to open account options.
tut_settings_s3_desc: View incoming real-time SSE broadcasts from civil defense command, mark notifications as read, or delete resolved alerts.
tut_settings_s3_hint: Click the notification bell to inspect incoming dispatches.
tut_dispatch_desc: Transmit multi-agency alerts, send SMS evacuation warnings to citizens, and email situational reports.
tut_dispatch_s1_desc: Review verified wildfire detections across Northern Algeria, filtered by severity (Crisis Alert, Very High, High) and status.
tut_dispatch_s1_hint: Click on 'Active Alerts' in the navigation bar.
tut_dispatch_s2_desc: Establish secure communications between Civil Protection (CODIS 1021) and Forest Conservation (DGF) to coordinate field interventions.
tut_dispatch_s2_hint: Click on the Intercom link to inspect the dispatch console.
tut_dispatch_s3_desc: Broadcast localized SMS alerts to nearby residents via Mobilis/Algérie Télécom, or dispatch official situational PDF/Email reports to authorities.
tut_dispatch_s3_hint: Click the navigation bar to finalize dispatch review.
tut_citizen_title: How to report & audit Citizen Signals
tut_citizen_desc: Review crowdsourced wildfire sightings, audit photographic evidence, and verify coordinates.
tut_citizen_s1_desc: Access advanced field capabilities including FLIR Drones, IoT Watchtowers, History Logs, and Citizen Reports under the 'More' menu.
tut_citizen_s1_hint: Click the 'More' dropdown menu to inspect extended tools.
tut_citizen_s2_desc: Citizen reports are geotagged and timestamped. Review smoke observations and uploaded photos to eliminate false alarms.
tut_citizen_s2_hint: Click 'Citizen Reports' to inspect submitted reports.
tut_citizen_s3_desc: Validate confirmed sightings against satellite infrared hotspots, and escalate directly to ground intervention units.
tut_citizen_s3_hint: Click the command panel switcher to complete the citizen workflow.
tut_ai_title: How to monitor AI Model Health
tut_ai_desc: Audit XGBoost accuracy, track ROC-AUC discrimination, and monitor NASA FIRMS API quotas.
tut_ai_s1_desc: Access scientific evaluations of the XGBoost classifier: holdout confusion matrix, ROC curve (AUC 0.986), and Gini feature importance.
tut_ai_s1_hint: Click on 'ML Analytics' in the navigation bar.
tut_ai_s2_desc: Verify statistical stability across retraining cycles, inspect sub-second latency, and monitor the hourly NASA FIRMS query budget.
tut_ai_s2_hint: Open the 'More' menu to access the Model Health module.
tut_ai_s3_desc: Execute instantaneous inference benchmarks calibrated for Greater Kabylie massifs to test latency under extreme weather conditions.
tut_ai_s3_hint: Click the INKAD brand logo to complete model verification.
tut_users_title: How to manage user accounts & roles
tut_users_desc: Provision authorized accounts, assign RBAC accreditations, and enforce institutional immutability rules.
tut_users_s1_desc: Only users authenticated with the Central Administration (ADMIN) role can access user creation, role editing, and account revocation.
tut_users_s1_hint: Click the 'More' menu to locate User Management.
tut_users_s2_desc: Create operational profiles for Civil Protection and Forest Conservation officers with assigned sector titles and emergency phone contacts.
tut_users_s2_hint: Click 'User Management' to inspect account listings.
tut_users_s3_desc: The root Super Admin account cannot be deleted or locked out. Email addresses are immutable after creation to preserve forensic audit trails.
tut_users_s3_hint: Click the command switcher to complete user management review.
